about.label: About
about.title: Who I Am
about.bio_1: I believe the future belongs to those who build it. I don't just observe change; I drive it through structured digital ecosystems that turn visionary ideas into real-world traction.
about.bio_2: My focus lies at the intersection of business strategy and technological scalability. Over recent years, I have architected and launched platforms like FiscEdge (business & AI education), Giurimi (advanced legal education), and The Italians (B2B digital storytelling), managing everything from inception to deployment.
about.bio_3: Whether it's developing the infrastructure for a tech startup or optimizing corporate workflows with Artificial Intelligence, my objective remains singular: creating concrete digital solutions that accelerate growth and define tomorrow's market.

together.title: BUILD SOMETHING TOGETHER
together.intro: Most of what you see here started as an idea, a problem or a rough prototype. I also work with selected founders, teams and companies to turn their ideas into real digital products.
together.detail: From an early concept to a working MVP, internal AI tool, automation or production-ready platform.
together.approach: I usually start from the problem, not the technology. Sometimes the answer is AI. Sometimes it's automation. Sometimes it's simply a better product.

buildWithMe.intro: I spend most of my time building my own products. For the right projects, I also partner with founders and companies to design and build products from idea to launch.
buildWithMe.detail: I occasionally work with founders, startups, professionals and established companies on projects where product, technology and business intersect.
buildWithMe.s1: A founder has an idea but needs a working MVP.
buildWithMe.s2: A company has a repetitive internal process that could be automated.
buildWithMe.s3: A team wants to introduce AI into an existing workflow.
buildWithMe.s4: A professional needs a custom platform instead of another generic SaaS subscription.
buildWithMe.s5: A company has an internal idea but doesn't have the product team to prototype it quickly.
buildWithMe.step1d: We define the actual problem, the user and what needs to exist.
buildWithMe.step2d: We turn the idea into a clear product scope and technical direction.
buildWithMe.step3d: I design and develop the first working version.
buildWithMe.step4d: We launch, measure what happens and improve from real usage.
